Definition: a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound)
BiblicalUsage: 1) conduit, water course, trench; 2) healing (of new flesh and skin forming over wound); 2a) (CLBL) bandage, plaister (for healing of wound)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
